description: Create a candidate, optionally with an application (job_id, stage_id) and resume text. Parse an attached resume yourself and pass the text via resume_text; never inline binary data.

job_id.description: Creates an application for this job

profile.description: Profile answers keyed by question text or question_id

resume_text.description: Plain text extracted from the resume; stored as a text/plain attachment. No binary or base64.

timezone.description: IANA, e.g. America/Los_Angeles; resolved from city and country if omitted

name: hires_create_candidate
